findings.precise_failure: tests/test_freshness.py::test_the_real_site_has_no_stale_or_undatable_payloads — 42 payloads served by the live site are stale or undatable
findings.root_cause: The test reads the deployed site, not the tree. The 42 payloads are stale because the nightly enrichment lanes have been starved while the morning contract has been failing. It is the same single failure at 3c17e494 (run 31900072819) and 0a57e221 (run 31898298559): one unresolved cause across all three, not three defects.
findings.required_source_change: none — the test is correct and must not be weakened, skipped, or excluded
findings.resolution_path: Repairing the morning contract and letting the enrichment lanes run refreshes the payloads; the test then passes on its own.

findings.failing_step: A batch that landed nothing is a failure, not a quiet success.
findings.precise_failure: GDELT fetch failed after 6 attempts for 2019-01-01..2019-12-31; HTTP 429 rate limit with the provider's message directing high-traffic users to the ngram files. Batch: 0 landed, 1 failed, 5 series still missing (10 -> 10).
findings.root_cause: Upstream rate limiting, not a local defect. The lane's fail-loud step is behaving exactly as designed: it refuses to record a no-data batch as progress.
findings.required_source_change: none for correctness. The no-data-is-not-success invariant must be preserved.
findings.open_design_question: Permanent red is operationally harmful. A distinct terminal state for authenticated upstream refusal would keep the lane visibly unavailable without presenting as a software failure. Changing the presented semantics needs a decision about which authority owns it; not taken unilaterally.

findings.precise_failure: EventLedgerError: calendar_partition_incomplete, raised by the in-lane gate's 'python -m src.event_ledger --check' on 9a0ff53e; publish correctly refused. The same log also shows FinalPublicationError: final_target_invalid earlier in the run.
findings.reproduction: python -m src.event_ledger --check on a clean checkout of current main

receipt_identity_payload_profile_invalid (exit 30/33), the transition deadlock repaired in 4c0d5b17. Run 31901393886 succeeded on the repaired SHA and published the first articles since 2026-08-07.

All four sit in the shared igrm-pipeline-v3 concurrency group. GitHub keeps at most one pending run per group, so each newer dispatch evicts the one waiting. This is the documented 2026-08-08 eviction pattern, not a software failure.
